profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Growing up in an engineering household, I've always had a love for engineering, intuitive design, and problem-solving. Software engineering was a way for me to combine all those passions. I thrive when working with a cohesive team with open communication and enjoy overcoming difficult technical challenges with both clever and simple solutions. I specialize in JavaScript and Node.js although I take pride in being an adaptable and flexible learner.

Shoot me a message and let's chat!
